'''Premium Droid Rentals''' was a [[droid]] rental store in the [[peacekeeping zone]] on the [[planet]] [[Plazir-15]]. A neon [[Aurebesh]] sign stating the business name, was used to attract potential customers. Underneath the name, "D7X" underneath (the number 7 was written in an [[Alternative Aurebesh numerals|alternative numeral system]] consisting of dots and lines), while two illegible words were written over the name.<ref name="Chapter 22" />
